identity: A mono-blue High Tide combo deck whose only intended win condition is Dark Depths. Mono-blue has no card that searches the library for a land, so the deck's binding constraint is not the thirty mana — it is drawing one mythic land out of forty cards, and nine of the twenty-three nonland slots exist purely to dig for it. The mana comes from stacking two multipliers on a monolithic basic-Island base: Gauntlet of Power makes every basic Island tap for two permanently, High Tide adds a third for a turn, and Turnabout, Peregrine Drake, Frantic Search, Snap and Cloud of Faeries untap those Islands again. Stroke of Genius is the honest concession — the same thirty mana that would strip ten ice counters instead decks the opponent in the roughly one game in five where Dark Depths never appears.

restrictions.extra_user_rule: At most 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard; basic lands unlimited

mainboard.name: Dark Depths
mainboard.oracle_text:
Dark Depths enters with ten ice counters on it.
{3}: Remove an ice counter from Dark Depths.
When Dark Depths has no ice counters on it, sacrifice it. If you do, create Marit Lage, a legendary 20/20 black Avatar creature token with flying and indestructible.

mainboard.name: Island
mainboard.role: Land — the High Tide and Gauntlet of Power multiplier

mainboard.name: Impulse
mainboard.oracle_text: Look at the top four cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the rest on the bottom of your library in any order.
mainboard.role: Find — digs four deep for Dark Depths

mainboard.name: Fact or Fiction
mainboard.oracle_text: Reveal the top five cards of your library. An opponent separates those cards into two piles. Put one pile into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
mainboard.role: Find — digs five deep; you choose the pile

mainboard.name: Deep Analysis
mainboard.oracle_text:
Target player draws two cards.
Flashback—{1}{U}, Pay 3 life. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its flashback cost. Then exile it.)
mainboard.role: Find — four cards from one slot via flashback

mainboard.name: Frantic Search
mainboard.oracle_text: Draw two cards, then discard two cards. Untap up to three lands.
mainboard.role: Find + engine — free untap and two cards deep

mainboard.name: High Tide
mainboard.oracle_text: Until end of turn, whenever a player taps an Island for mana, that player adds an additional {U}.
mainboard.role: Engine — doubles every Island for a turn

mainboard.name: Turnabout
mainboard.oracle_text: Choose artifact, creature, or land. Tap all untapped permanents of the chosen type target player controls, or untap all tapped permanents of that type that player controls.

mainboard.name: Cloud of Faeries
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, untap up to two lands.
Cycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Draw a card.)
mainboard.role: Engine — untap two lands; cycles when mana is not the problem

mainboard.name: Snap
mainboard.oracle_text: Return target creature to its owner's hand. Untap up to two lands.
mainboard.role: Engine + interaction — free bounce, untaps two lands

mainboard.name: Mind Stone
mainboard.oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Draw a card.
mainboard.role: Ramp — accelerates to a turn-4 Gauntlet of Power

mainboard.name: Gauntlet of Power
mainboard.oracle_text:
As this artifact enters, choose a color.
Creatures of the chosen color get +1/+1.
Whenever a basic land is tapped for mana of the chosen color, its controller adds an additional one mana of that color.
mainboard.role: Engine — a permanent High Tide on every basic Island

mainboard.name: Force of Will
mainboard.oracle_text:
You may pay 1 life and exile a blue card from your hand rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Counter target spell.
mainboard.role: Interaction — zero-mana protection on the burst turn

mainboard.name: Stroke of Genius
mainboard.role: Backup payoff — decks the opponent off the same 30 mana

mainboard.name: Peregrine Drake
mainboard.oracle_text:
Flying
When this creature enters, untap up to five lands.
mainboard.role: Engine — untaps five lands unconditionally; a 2/3 flying blocker

mainboard.name: Jalum Tome
mainboard.oracle_text: {2}, {T}: Draw a card, then discard a card.
mainboard.role: Find — the deck's only REPEATABLE digger

sideboard.name: Tormod's Crypt
sideboard.oracle_text: {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Exile target player's graveyard.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs the cube's 45 graveyard cards — flashback, threshold, reanimator

sideboard.name: Circular Logic
sideboard.oracle_text:
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {1} for each card in your graveyard.
Madness {U} (If you discard this card, discard it into exile. When you do, cast it for its madness cost or put it into your graveyard.)
sideboard.when_to_board: vs control and combo — 18 of the 23 nonland cards are instants or sorceries that bin themselves on resolution, so the tax is hard by turn 6

sideboard.name: Floodgate
sideboard.oracle_text:
Defender
When this creature has flying, sacrifice it.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, it deals damage to each nonblue creature without flying equal to half the number of Islands you control, rounded down.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature decks — a 0/5 Defender that on leaving the battlefield deals half your Island count to each nonblue non-flying creature; on a realistic turn-6 board of 8-12 Islands that is 4-6 damage

sideboard.name: Ovinize
sideboard.oracle_text: Until end of turn, target creature loses all abilities and has base power and toughness 0/1.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs a lone fatty, regenerator or protection-from-colour creature

sideboard.name: Confiscate
sideboard.oracle_text:
Enchant permanent
You control enchanted permanent.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs a key artifact or enchantment — mono-blue has no destroy effect at all, so stealing it is the only answer available

sideboard.name: Maze of Ith
sideboard.oracle_text: {T}: Untap target attacking creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by that creature this turn.
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature aggro — swap for a Mishra's Factory, not an Island, so the High Tide count is untouched

sideboard.name: Man-o'-War
sideboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, return target creature to its owner's hand.
sideboard.role: Bounce on a body + Floodgate trigger
sideboard.when_to_board: vs creature decks — 'return target creature to its owner's hand' on a 2/2, and a second on-demand way to make Floodgate leave the battlefield and fire its sweeper trigger

identity_es: Un mazo de combo High Tide mono azul cuya única condición de victoria prevista es Dark Depths. El mono azul no tiene ninguna carta que busque una tierra en la biblioteca, así que la restricción del mazo no son los treinta manás: es robar una tierra mítica de entre cuarenta cartas, y nueve de los veintitrés huecos no-tierra existen puramente para cavar a por ella. El maná viene de acumular dos multiplicadores sobre una base monolítica de Islands básicas: Gauntlet of Power hace que cada Island básica gire por dos de forma permanente, High Tide añade una tercera durante un turno, y Turnabout, Peregrine Drake, Frantic Search, Snap y Cloud of Faeries vuelven a desgirar esas Islands. Stroke of Genius es la concesión honesta: esos mismos treinta manás que quitarían diez contadores de hielo deckean al rival en aproximadamente una de cada cinco partidas en las que Dark Depths nunca aparece.
